newsitem.title: CHILE: RESEARCH ALERT - Santiago reduce reiterated.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Santiago reduce reiterated.

text.p: Flemings Research reiterated its "reduce" rating on Chilean private bank Banco Santiago.

A report by Analyst Jorge Scarinci cited the bank's $20 million first quarter earnings, from $23.2 million in the same quarter last year on a pro-forma basis, and a planned $150 million equity issue and the Central Bank's efforts to sell its own 38.5 percent stake in the bank.
Those two issues, plus the poor quarterly results, will put additional downward pressure on the bank's share price, said the report.
